chunks: It is He who created the night and the day, the sun and the moon; each is floating in an orbit.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the movement of the sun and moon?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the precise, divinely ordained motion of celestial bodies, serving as a tangible sign of Tawhid (Divine Unity) and the order of creation. It is frequently cited to illustrate the harmony between the physical cosmos and spiritual reality, reinforcing the concept that all creation submits to God's will through its designated path.
